matrix.details: Persistent topology IDs (vertices, edges, faces, cylinders, planes) mapped directly to QIF Features.
Topology persistent UUIDs preserved across QIF Feature representations.
Linear, angular, and diametral dimensions mapped to QIF Characteristics with nominals and limits.
Position, Flatness, Perpendicularity, Concentricity mapped with material conditions and datum reference frames.
Symmetric, bilateral, and limit tolerances mapped with upper/lower deviations.
Datums A, B, C with primary, secondary, tertiary precedence and target geometry references preserved.
Millimeter, Meter, and Inch units normalized with explicit scale factors.
Deterministic persistent IDs used for all features, characteristics, and results.
Design revision IDs (REV-A, REV-B) explicitly bound to measurement contexts.
Complete QIF InspectionPlan generated from MBD specifications.
CMM touch trigger / digital micrometer actual values, deviations, and timestamps recorded.
Expanded uncertainty U = k * sqrt(u_inst^2 + u_env^2 + u_rep^2) explicitly calculated and applied.
Instrument type, resolution, inherent uncertainty, and calibration standards recorded.
Calibration records with expiration dates strictly validated.
Cryptographic evidence hashes bound to every measurement result and feedback proposal.
Guard-banded PASS, FAIL, INDETERMINATE, CALIBRATION_EXPIRED, and DESIGN_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED verdicts computed.
Engineering revision proposals (REV-A -> REV-B) generated without direct CAD state mutation.
